name: universal
algorithm: imitation of the reference driver's law (DAgger), then PPO on the NumPy batched model: 3000 iterations x 256 cars x 32 steps, 1500 x 256 x 64 with fsdsim's exact cone check, 700 x 256 x 64 fine-tuning at lr 1.5e-4 (about 61 M car-steps, 1 CPU core, ~3.5 h)

validation.suite: held-out: accel, skidpad, 8 autocross layouts x baseline + 8 sampled setups
